question.text: Under FATF Special Recommendation III (SR III), countries are required to freeze terrorist funds or other assets in accordance with the relevant UN Security Council resolutions. What is the prescribed timeline for freezing such assets?

answer.text: Only after obtaining a court order

explanation.text: The Logic: SR III requires countries to freeze terrorist funds or other assets without delay in accordance with the relevant UN Security Council resolutions and to be able to adopt legislative measures necessary to enable seizure or confiscation of such property where appropriate. The Trap: "Within 48 hours" or "within 7 working days" sound reasonable but inject a delay inconsistent with the "without delay" standard. "After court order" would defeat the purpose of the freezing obligation under the UN resolutions. Note: The exam-relevant phrase is exactly "without delay" — anything that introduces a fixed waiting period or external precondition is wrong against the SR III wording.
